meta.description: Maps legacy MISO market-report column headers and report names to (a) the no-auth Real-Time Web Displays Data Broker and (b) the MISO Data Exchange REST API that replaces the retiring public market reports.
source: backend/data/references/miso_data_exchange_report_to_endpoint_mapping.pdf (MISO's own official legacy-report -> Data Exchange endpoint table, pulled 2026-09-04)

status_legend.verified: Legacy field and target endpoint both confirmed against a live response or official MISO doc (including MISO's own Report to Endpoint Mapping PDF).
status_legend.tentative: Mapping is correct in intent; exact Data Exchange REST path/JSON key still to be confirmed against the developer portal (needs an account). Tracked in NOTES_data_provenance.md.
status_legend.deprecated: Legacy source is being retired with no like-for-like public replacement; note the migration path.

key_dates.2026-09-30: MISO stops posting Pricing and LGI (Load, Generation & Interchange) market reports on the public Market Reports page (per the live notice on misoenergy.org as of 2026-09-04). Data Exchange becomes the sole source of record. Past reports remain available until they expire.

field_notes.official_endpoint_name: Where present on a 'current' object, this is the exact endpoint name from MISO's own Report to Endpoint Mapping PDF (backend/data/references/) -- treat it as verified. 'endpoint' remains our best-guess REST path/slug and stays tentative until confirmed in the Data Exchange developer portal.

known_gotchas: Legacy reports label time as 'Hour Ending' (HE 1..24) in Eastern Prevailing Time; Data Exchange returns ISO-8601 UTC. HE n = interval (n-1):00-n:00 EPT.
DST transition days have 23 or 25 hourly rows.
Real-time LMPs are preliminary for ~3-5 days, then finalized ('ExPost final'). Use finalized data for any historical dataset.
The RTWD Data Broker endpoints are labeled 'Deprecated' by MISO but remain live and require no key; treat them as best-effort current-snapshot only, not a historical archive.

entries.legacy_report: Nearly all hourly market reports (e.g. rt_lmp_final.csv, da_expost_lmp.csv)
entries.legacy_description: Hour-ending index 1-24 in Eastern Prevailing Time.
entries.formula_note: local_hour_ending = ceil(to_EPT(timestamp).hour + (minute>0 ? 1 : 0)); HE 24 maps to the interval ending at 00:00 EPT the next day.
entries.gotchas: Convert UTC -> America/New_York before deriving HE. Handle 23-/25-hour DST days.

entries.legacy_description: Commercial Pricing Node identifier: a hub, load zone, interface, or generator/load node.
entries.formula_note: Hub CPNodes (e.g. INDIANA.HUB) are fixed-weight aggregations of EPNodes; their LMP is the weighted average of constituent EPNode LMPs.
entries.gotchas: MISO South hub tokens differ from Midwest (verify exact spelling of LOUISIANA/TEXAS/ARKANSAS/MS hubs against a live consolidated-table pull).

entries.legacy_report: rt_lmp_final.csv / Real-Time Final Market LMPs, LMP Consolidated Table
entries.legacy_description: Total locational marginal price at the node, in USD/MWh.
entries.gotchas: RT 5-minute values are averaged to hourly HE in the legacy hourly report.

entries.legacy_description: Marginal energy component of LMP, common to all nodes for a given interval.

current.official_endpoint_name: Real-Time Ex-Post LMP, Aggregated Pnode (component sub-field)

entries.formula_note: Equal across every node in an interval; equals LMP at the reference/load-weighted bus.
entries.gotchas: Some legacy files omit this column and expect energy = LMP_TOTAL - MCC - MLC. The parent LMP endpoint is confirmed (see lmp_total); the exact sub-field name for this component is not.

entries.legacy_description: Marginal congestion component of LMP at the node relative to the reference bus.

current.official_endpoint_name: Real-Time Ex-Post LMP, Aggregated Pnode (component sub-field)

entries.formula_note: Sum over binding constraints of (shadow_price * shift_factor_node). Can be positive or negative.
entries.gotchas: Sign convention: positive MCC raises local price (import-constrained). Parent endpoint confirmed; sub-field name not.

entries.legacy_description: Marginal loss component of LMP at the node relative to the reference bus.

current.official_endpoint_name: Real-Time Ex-Post LMP, Aggregated Pnode (component sub-field)

entries.formula_note: Positive at electrically distant load; negative near generation.
entries.gotchas: Reference bus choice affects the split between energy and loss; totals are invariant. Parent endpoint confirmed; sub-field name not.

entries.legacy_description: Financially binding day-ahead hourly LMP at the node.
entries.formula_note: spread = rt_lmp - da_lmp (the day-ahead / real-time convergence measure).
entries.gotchas: Distinguish DA Ex-Ante ('Day-Ahead Ex-Ante LMP, Aggregated Pnode') vs Ex-Post; the legacy 'da_expost_lmp' file is Ex-Post.

entries.legacy_report: rt_lmp_final.csv / rt_lmp_prelim.csv / Real-Time Final & Preliminary Market LMPs
entries.legacy_description: Real-time hourly (5-minute-averaged) ex-post LMP at the node.
entries.formula_note: hourly_HE = mean(twelve 5-minute ex-post intervals in the clock hour).
entries.gotchas: 'prelim' vs 'final': use final (settles ~3-5 business days later) for datasets. Ex-ante 5-min variant maps to 'Real-Time Ex-Ante LMP, Aggregated Pnode'.

entries.legacy_report: asm_expost_damcp.csv / asm_rtmcp_final.csv / ASM Day-Ahead & Real-Time Market MCPs
entries.legacy_description: Ex-post market clearing price for each operating-reserve product, by reserve zone.

current.official_endpoint_name: Day-Ahead Ex-Post MCP (DA) / Real-Time Ex-Post MCP (RT); ex-ante variants also published

entries.formula_note: Products: Regulating, Spinning, Supplemental, Short-Term Reserve. Cleared per reserve zone, co-optimized with energy.
entries.gotchas: Short-Term Reserve exists only from 2022 onward. Endpoint does not break out product-level sub-fields in the official mapping doc -- confirm JSON shape in the dev portal.

entries.legacy_report: Generation Fuel Mix (report 7230) / Historical Generation Fuel Mix
entries.legacy_description: Actual generation in MW by fuel category, updated every 5 minutes.

current.official_endpoint_name: Day-Ahead Generation Fuel Type / Real-Time Generation Fuel Type

entries.gotchas: Broker categories: Coal, Gas, Nuclear, Hydro, Wind, Solar, Other. 'Other' bundles oil, biomass, storage discharge, etc.

entries.legacy_report: Real-Time Total Load; Daily Regional Forecast and Actual Load (report 3031)
entries.legacy_description: Actual and forecast MISO-wide (and regional) demand in MW.

current.official_endpoint_name: Medium Term Load Forecast / Actual Load

entries.formula_note: daily_peak = max(hourly actual load over HE 1..24).
entries.gotchas: Broker payload also carries Medium-Term Load Forecast (MTLF); pick the actual series for historical peaks.

entries.legacy_description: Actual real-time wind generation, MISO-wide, in MW.
entries.formula_note: Record wind peak in fuel_peaks.json = all-time max of this series.
entries.gotchas: Solar equivalent: messageType=getSolarActual. Not explicitly listed as its own row in MISO's Report to Endpoint Mapping PDF; likely folded into a broader LGI generation endpoint -- confirm in the dev portal.

entries.legacy_description: Day-ahead hourly wind generation forecast, MISO-wide, in MW.
entries.gotchas: Solar equivalent: messageType=getSolarForecast. Broker timestamps are labeled EST. Not explicitly listed in MISO's Report to Endpoint Mapping PDF -- confirm in the dev portal.

entries.legacy_report: Net Scheduled Interchange (real-time display); Historical NSI (report 2010)
entries.legacy_description: Net MW scheduled to flow across MISO's borders for the interval.
entries.formula_note: Positive = net import into MISO (convention to confirm).
entries.gotchas: Net Actual Interchange (NAI) is a separate series; ACE relates the two.

entries.legacy_report: Real-Time Binding Constraints; Real-Time Expanded Report (report 1464); Day-Ahead Binding Constraints (rt_bc_xxx.csv)
entries.legacy_description: Transmission constraints that bound the dispatch, with their shadow prices in USD/MWh.
entries.formula_note: A node's congestion component is built from these shadow prices weighted by shift factors.
entries.gotchas: Constraint names are not stable identifiers across MTEP model updates. Day-Ahead Binding Constraints endpoint not explicitly confirmed -- only the Real-Time variant appears in the official mapping doc.

entries.legacy_report: MTEP annual report + Appendix A/B/C project tables (PDF/XLS on misoenergy.org)
entries.legacy_description: Board-approved transmission project portfolio: project ID, description, cost, miles, in-service date, driver.
entries.formula_note: Summarized in backend/data/mtep_projects.json by portfolio (local_mtep / lrtp / jtiq).
entries.gotchas: No public API. Project lists are published as report appendices; refresh annually after board approval (December).

entries.legacy_description: All active/withdrawn/executed interconnection requests: MW, fuel type, county, POI, queue status.
entries.formula_note: Feeds the 'View Active Solar in Queue' follow-up in related_queries.json.
entries.gotchas: Published as a downloadable spreadsheet, refreshed roughly weekly; no REST endpoint.
